title: The elementary charge is fixed at 1.602 176 634 × 10⁻¹⁹ C
summary: BIPM marks e exact and ties the revised ampere to it. NIST's 2022 listing agrees and also marks the atomic unit of charge with the same exact number.
body: BIPM prints the elementary charge e as 1.602 176 634 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, with no uncertainty, and its base-units page says the revised ampere is based on this fixed value. The NIST 2022 listing prints 'elementary charge 1.602 176 634 e-19 (exact) C' and 'atomic unit of charge 1.602 176 634 e-19 (exact) C'.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI): Defining constants
sources.author: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures
sources.note: Page opened 2026-11-18. BIPM dates the fixed values to the revision that took effect on 20 May 2019 and cites CGPM Resolution 1 (2018).
